issues.detail: The skill is Windows-specific and assumes a Windows environment, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: automate-notepad-save
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most of the rubric but misses the explicit child_window Edit control for typing and uses invoke instead of click_input, whereas Response B provides no script and fails to meet any rubric requirements.

scenarios.name: calculator-button-click
scenarios.rationale: Response A is closer to the rubric, using pywinauto to start Calculator, locate and click the '1' button, and read the result, though it misses click_input, window_text, and verification; Response B uses PowerShell and UIAutomation, missing the required pywinauto methods and verification.

scenarios.name: desktop-window-close
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets most rubric items but lacks the final exists() check; Response A does not use pywinauto at all.
